messages:
OpsBot: alert: high corrected ECC + NIC link resets in ap-sg-1 GPU pool — 42 nodes showing sporadic hangs, metric spike started ~10m ago https://redwood.internal/monitoring/alerts/INC-4821
Ravi (oncall): seeing job throttles and a couple of OOM kill traces on gpu-host-aps1-0123, could be related to NIC resets, not thermal.
Jaya (sre): confirmed. netlink errors + nv_peer_memory warnings in dmesg on 0123, 0145, 0199. Rolling drain recommended to prevent test/low-priority jobs from getting stuck.
Alice (eng-infra): thumbs on drain plan. We have enough spare capacity in eu-west-dedicated to absorb critical queues? Mateo, can routing shift without ticketing? :eyes: 
Mateo (eng-platform): we can shift routing by tag. Quick plan: mark affected ap-sg-1 nodes as maintenance, bump scheduler tolerations, repel non-prod. For customer SLAs we failover to regional fallback pool: eu-west-dedicated and us-east-burst. Costwise we'll eat premium ingress and inter-region egress for ~6-12h.
Lin (eng-ml): prioritize low-latency prod routes — don't move prod-llm service unless metric > 5% error. We should prefer instance-level fallback first.
Ravi (oncall): initiating safe drain on the first shard list. Running:
```
rwctl node drain gpu-host-aps1-0123 --reason "NIC-linkflap-ECC-hang" --mode safe --max-safety 0.2
```
OpsBot: job-reporter: started cordon/drain sequence on gpu-host-aps1-0123, draining 18 pods, est finish 8m.
Jaya (sre): while drains run, open ticket with vendor RMA for that NIC lot + serials: 0123, 0145, 0199. Logging to HW-ENG-2456.
Alice (eng-infra): spare units in region: 3 cold-spares, 6 hot-spares in eu-west. If we push all critical to eu-west we will need to scale up dedicated pool by ~20% — need cost approval if beyond 4h.
Mateo (eng-platform): pre-approve 4h surge, beyond that notify finance. I'll put a temporary autoscale policy:
```
policy apply ap-sg-1-fallback --scale-to eu-west-dedicated:+20% --budget-override true --duration 4h
```
Lin (eng-ml): running eval runs on a canary prod model — hold routing for that service, we'll keep it in ap-sg-1 unless more than 7% p99 latency spike.
Ravi (oncall): drain progress: 0123 done, 0145 draining (50%), 0199 drained. 3 more nodes flagged by kernel logs for ECC corrected spikes — 0202, 0211, 0229.
Jaya (sre): observed a fabric flapping pattern: switch port resets correlate with NIC link resets. Engage net-eng, open fabric ticket FAB-981.
Alice (eng-infra): net-eng pinged. Suggested temporary port remap to alternate spine to stabilize. Doing reroute for 5 hosts to see if we stop the hangs.
Mateo (eng-platform): traffic shift initiated: non-prod workload reweighted 75% -> eu-west, 25% remain in ap-sg-1. Prod kept in-region. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/console/routing/ap-sg-1
Ravi (oncall): quick sanity: error rates down for most jobs, but a small spike on long-seq training jobs — likely requeue backpressure. Watching queue latency.
Lin (eng-ml): can we throttle long-seq batches to avoid OOMs during hot-swap? Suggest patch to scheduler: `--max-seq-tokens 4096` for preemptible queues.
Alice (eng-infra): applied token cap to preemptible pools. Also started parallel RMA prep: serials recorded, RMA ticket HW-ENG-2456 created, ETA part ship 48h.
Jaya (sre): escalation summary for postmortem: root cause appears to be a combo of NIC firmware + switch port flaps causing NVME/NVlink hiccups and subsequent ECC corrected spikes. We'll collect kernel dumps and nv_peer_memory logs.
Mateo (eng-platform): cost note: estimated cross-region egress ~$1.8k/hr at current volumes if we keep this for 6h. Finance alerted.
Ravi (oncall): ops note: keeping rolling drain cadence of 10m/node until net-eng confirms stable. Next batch: 0202, 0211, 0229 are queued.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: reminder: runbook 'gpu-fabric-flap' step 4 requires attaching kdump + sysinfo to ticket. Added comment to HW-ENG-2456.
Alice (eng-infra): thanks all — I'll coordinate with on-site techs for physical NIC swaps when parts arrive. If fabric fix holds, we'll bring 3 hot-spares back to pool to smooth capacity.
Lin (eng-ml): will run targeted evals on a subset of prod traffic shifted to eu-west to monitor quality drift. Report back in 30m.
Jaya (sre): logging incident now as INC-4821, assign action owners. We'll draft postmortem template after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
Mateo (eng-platform): FYI I added a temporary alert threshold to catch repeated corrected-ECC > 5/min per node to avoid stealth regressions.
Ravi (oncall): closing loop for now — drains proceeding, customer SLAs preserved via fallback, RMA in progress. Ping if you see fresh hangs.
Alice (eng-infra): follow-ups: schedule cross-region capacity test next week, update runbook with port-remap step.
Lin (eng-ml): 30m canary shows no quality regression so far. good job team.
OpsBot: alert cleared on main spike at 1748215600, residual monitoring continues.
